title: oplismenus hirtellus subsp. japonicus
intro: Oplismenus hirtellus subsp. japonicus, commonly known as Japanese Piggymillipede grass, is a subspecies of the Oplismenus hirtellus plant, a type of grass native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its traditional use in medicine, particularly in Japan, where it is used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oplismenus hirtellus subsp. japonicus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
